rationale: This is a motor vehicle collision causing severe damage to the policyholder's vehicle and bodily injury to the policyholder, clearly within auto coverage.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 AM yesterday by a vehicle traveling 35 mph without braking. The vehicle is totaled with the trunk crushed into the back seat. Pat sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is documented on the police report.

case_facts.description: Rear-ended by other vehicle traveling at approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: Totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.other_driver_info: Insurance details available on police report
